web.orders: the dedicated Order Status Feed socket (createWsToken, then orderToken and userId)

notes: AliceBlue streams five levels; LTP and Quote ride the touchline (t), Depth the depth feed (d), on the Noren socket the web opens after createWsSess.

Since web #2473 the web's dicts carry every quote field the snapshot holds (OHLC, volume, average price, trade quantity, book totals, OI as total_oi and oi, the change as change_percent and percent_change, circuits, ltt as last_trade_time), no symbol, exchange or mode, and its ltt and Depth timestamp are AliceBlue's feed time in epoch seconds: see each case's deviations.
